options.text: Delete the pending grant so the user can no longer see what was decided.
Transition it to Active and immediately schedule a revoke.
Mark it Denied and retain the audit record.

feedback.reason: Use a distinct terminal outcome that records denial without making the authority active. In this case, Mark it Denied and retain the audit record.

details.mechanismOrProperty: Grant owns its lifecycle and decision record; Active is reachable only through approval.
details.scenarioApplication: A denied grant remains explainable and never provides the permission.
details.errorCorrection: The prompt requires an audit record of the denial. That creates an interval of authority despite the reviewer denying it.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: A later request should have a new review identity rather than altering the denied decision.
details.transfer: Model rejection as its own result instead of conflating it with activation or deletion.

beforeQuestion.prompt: A notarization request seals a document revision only after the signer confirms the displayed digest. A changed revision has a different digest. Choose what to do when the document changes after confirmation but before sealing.

options.text: Restore the earlier revision silently and seal that revision.
Do not seal; require confirmation of the changed revision’s digest.
Seal the latest revision using the earlier confirmation because the document ID is unchanged.

feedback.reason: Guard an irreversible transition with the exact state version that was confirmed. In this case, Do not seal; require confirmation of the changed revision’s digest.

details.mechanismOrProperty: The seal transition binds to a confirmed revision digest.
details.scenarioApplication: No seal can claim a signer confirmed content they did not see.
details.errorCorrection: The confirmation is for a different digest, even though the document identity stayed the same. The prompt does not authorize silently discarding the newer document state.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: A user can review and confirm the new revision to continue.
details.transfer: Tie an irreversible state transition to the exact version on which its prerequisite was satisfied.

messages.text: The prompt does not authorize silently discarding the newer document state.

beforeQuestion.prompt: A seller payout moves from Ready to Released after settlement. A release request may be retried after a timeout; the payment provider returns the same transfer reference for a repeated request ID. Choose how to handle a timeout when the release outcome is not yet visible to the caller.

options.text: Retry with the same payout request ID and reconcile the returned transfer reference before reporting Released.
Create a new request ID so the provider can attempt the payout again immediately.
Mark the payout Released as soon as the request is sent.

feedback.reason: Make a retry converge on the same transition rather than creating another release. In this case, Retry with the same payout request ID and reconcile the returned transfer reference before reporting Released.

details.mechanismOrProperty: Payout owns its release state and stable request identity; the provider reference resolves the attempt.
details.scenarioApplication: The retry can discover the first release without creating a second one.
details.errorCorrection: A second identity can request a second transfer while the first result is unknown. A timeout does not prove the provider completed the release.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If the provider does not guarantee repeated request identity, the scenario needs a different reconciliation contract.
details.transfer: Represent an uncertain external outcome as pending until evidence confirms the state transition.

messages.text: A second identity can request a second transfer while the first result is unknown.
A timeout does not prove the provider completed the release.
